source_notes: This is the operator the GUI still labels Bloom. It is the positive medium's conservative scatter, applied after B2 on display-linear output.

Measured in P0: half-energy radius 0.759 mm, energy ratio ~1e-10 (conservative as designed), but only 0.73 EV of overrange exists in the domain it runs in against 6.00 EV in the scene. P3 moves the editorial glow to a scene-linear operator and leaves this one as the small medium effect it actually is.
viewing_scatter stays null: no paper PSF/CTF data exists, and the plan refuses to let a display-linear blur stand in for one.
